reviews.title: Exemplary Customer Support
reviews.text:
I never have written a review for an app but felt that the support I’ve received from the MeAgain staff warranted saying something. I have been using the app daily for four months. During the first month I bought a new iPhone and was trying to migrate my data from the old phone. I had quite a mess. Customer support and assistance from Rodrigo (a co-founder of MeAgain) was stellar. He really went above and beyond to ensure my issue was completely resolved. Once migrated into the new phone, I was having duplicate notifications. I did a lot of troubleshooting with Apple and finally decided to reach out to MeAgain support. Once again Rodrigo was involved and really went the extra mile to resolve the issue. I’m thrilled to be using this app to support me during my GLP1 experience. It has been very helpful to see the medication level estimates to be able to plan injections and meals around that. I’m a data driven person and the app has aided me in losing 47 lbs during these four months. I have a lengthy journey ahead of me but know that the MeAgain team will be there to support my efforts with ongoing enhancements to the app every step of the way.

Edited to add: I’ve been using the app for over a year now. The developer keeps making amazing improvements to the app - and it has been a wonderful (essential) tool helping me with my loss of 120 lbs at this point. - 105 while using the app.

reviews.title: First time leaving a review… so
reviews.text:
If you are on a GLP-1 journey and struggling to stay consistent, track your nutrition, or simply manage all the details that come with treatment, this app can honestly become a game changer. I’ve been using it for over 300 days, every single day, and I can confidently say my progress would have been significantly harder without it.

What makes this app different is that it’s not just another weight-loss tracker. It helps you build structure and consistency around the things that actually matter during GLP-1 treatment: protein intake, hydration, calories, progress tracking, and even injection reminders. Instead of feeling overwhelmed trying to manage everything mentally, the app creates clarity and accountability in a very simple and practical way.

For anyone serious about succeeding with GLP-1 treatment, I genuinely recommend giving it a try.

reviews.title: A good tracker, even without a subscription
reviews.text:
This app is a useful tracker for my GLP-1 adventure.  I know I am not taking advantage of all the features, even all the free ones, but it’s doing what I need. It integrates with my iPhone to track weight and steps, and even estimates when I will reach my goal!  I track protein and fiber, side effects, weight, and medication level.  It’s all on the dashboard!

I don’t like how difficult it was to restore the app after a recent update. At first it appeared to be bricked. It took a reinstall, and a few restarts to get it working again. Annoying. But it did come back, and my data was intact. Custom service was responsive.
